scope: Evidence field/date inventory only; no action-value returns computed

field_sufficiency.D: C11 account_daily cash/quantity/close at E2; exact existing entry quantity cross-checked
field_sufficiency.X: C11 account_daily cash/quantity/close/equity at E6; subsequent residual position must remain marked, with no invented sale fee
field_sufficiency.H: Original C11 quantity plus published EX019 horizon=6 fill-attempt price/date, existing 0.1% sell fee and D residual cash
field_sufficiency.C: D cash plus original sell quantity/price/fee; preserve cash thereafter. Do not use original daily cash after later reentry.
field_sufficiency.status: All 146 E6-observable events have complete fields; terminal event retained as missing/censored

limits: This inventory does not compute H-X, H-C or X-C outcomes.
E6 close is a fixed common valuation endpoint; no account strategy has been run.
Observed dates and execution availability must not be used as contemporaneous predictive signals.
Annual cohort counts are by entry or decision year, never annual account returns.
Missing terminal dates are null; no zero imputation or forced terminal exit.
Existing H3 and H6 results are reused; no independently unseen sample is claimed.
